description:
The presence Pookie senses at the pier later surfaces as a ghostly Lapras. The story asks the player to move from fear to attachment before discovering its disturbing secret and, much later, its connection to a Water/Ghost legendary.

Proposed individual behavior: it begins to turn toward the child’s approaching footsteps before the lighthouse beam reaches its shell. Familiarity comes from repeated shore meetings in the Lapras arc; the child learns to respect its resting distance. Neither refusal nor departure makes it hostile.

data.description: Planned arc, developed through proposed repeated shore meetings: fear gives way to recognition and attachment before the unsettling fact and the late legendary connection. Recruitment remains undecided.
The existing apparition is glimpsed from Shiohama’s pier after the earlier unseen presence sensed by Pookie. Later repeated meetings nearby are proposed; the first bark still reveals no creature.
Its magic is revealed near the end, after attachment and the unsettling discovery. The scar has no established explanation.
